method:
chip_shock_study.py - "If NIFTY / BANKNIFTY fall Monday, which chip-dependent F&O shares can fall MORE?" (desk 21 Nov 2026 16:40). Pure code, no AI.
EVENTS  US session D with the PHLX Semiconductor index (^SOX) close <= -5% vs its previous close; separately Nasdaq Composite <= -4.5%.
        India's NEXT session N = first NSE day after D (India closes before the US opens). Previous close = the NSE close before N.
DATA    Yahoo daily ^SOX / ^IXIC (raw in /home/globalbot/girdata/ext/chip_shock_study/raw/, read as data only). India: Kite day candles
        history/eq_<SYM>.npz and ix_*.npz (Nov 2021 -> 20 Nov 2026); minutes hist_fresh/min/<SYM>.npz (UTC epoch, Nov 2023 -> 19 Nov 2026) and
        girdata/minute/<day>/<SYM>__eq.npz (IST wall clock; Kite spot minutes stop at 15:14). F&O list = NSE F&O bhavcopy 20 Nov 2026.
PER SHARE on N: open gap, low, close vs previous close; close minus NIFTY's close (pct points); low of the day inside 09:15-09:29 (minutes).
CONTROL NIFTY 50, NIFTY BANK, and every other F&O share (each chip name is ranked against the whole F&O list).
RANK    'most likely to fall more' = lowest median (close vs previous close minus NIFTY's), ties by the share of events it lagged NIFTY.
        n < 10 -> NOT PROVEN; everything here is history, a LESSON, not a rule.
  python3 -I chip_shock_study.py fetch | (no arg) -> report + json + lesson
